provenance.method: Loaded and answered Make music at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Make music requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Make music requests on a short fixed test input.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Make music requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.
